scopePolicy: Every non-test Go file in internal/handler and internal/service containing a registered Repository, Service, or Coordinator dependency symbol must appear exactly once in scanScopes; files without such symbols are excluded by rule except explicitly registered split receiver methods that retain their receiver owner. localOwnerPorts separately registers typed local capabilities, owner-local credential reads and composition, with an exact production call-site guard. localCountOwnerPorts separately registers context-aware, account-scoped, bounded count-only RPT capabilities and their exact owner methods and composition; these are not remote contracts. localTextOwnerPorts separately registers the synchronous MSG-to-CHN text capability, credential-free intent/binding/status/result values, owner-local credential reads and provider operations, opaque dispatch preparation, and exact combined-router composition; standalone module-server does not compose this local capability and no remote transport contract is implied. localFirebaseConfigOwnerPorts separately registers the context-aware, fixed-key, bounded private NTF-to-SYS Firebase configuration read and its sole combined-router composition. Credentials remain local to this capability and NTF transport; this is not sys.configuration.get.v1, a remote credential API, or a startup dependency.
